about.label: About
about.headline: Engineering and translation done right, with the experience to back it up.
about.body: Pelaj Studios combines software development with local administrative knowledge and professional translation experience. Our systems are reliable, efficient, and vigorously tested, both in software and in translation.
about.support: Our translation team has more than 20 years of industry experience with multinational, well-known organizations on serious cases. On the software side, we focus on distributed systems, automation and dashboards that lead to correct decision making.

whyUs.label: Why us?
whyUs.headline: We prefer quality, reliability, and efficiency over quick fixes.
whyUs.description: Our software and translation is unbeatable in terms of quality, security, and efficiency. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, scalability, and correct results over all else.

reasons.title: Systems Thinking
reasons.description: We build everything with a systems-based approach, even when it comes to the simplest of software or even a single page of translation.

reasons.title: Senior Translation Experience
reasons.description: Our translation work is backed by over two decades in professional and multinational environments.

reasons.title: No Delay Policy
reasons.description: Our deadlines are longer, but they are always met. We believe that everything that is robust takes time and real effort. This is the Pelaj Studios guarantee.

reasons.title: Local Execution
reasons.description: Kosovo-based delivery, direct communication and enough administrative context to understand institutional workflows.

contact.label: Contact
contact.headline: Bring us the hard part.
contact.description: Send the system, workflow, map, dashboard, procurement document or translation requirement you are dealing with. We will tell you what can be built, clarified or improved.

payments.label: Payments
payments.headline: Pay in the way that works for you.
payments.description: We currently accept Visa, Mastercard, Paysera, TEB Bank, Raiffeisen Bank, ProCredit Bank, and other local payment methods.
